function.name: FarTransfer_InteractionCounterStepBack
behavior: Returns without changing the word when 0x00FFEFE0 is "00".
Decrements the low ASCII digit at 0x00FFEFE1.
When the low digit crosses below '0', reloads it to '9' and decrements the high ASCII digit at 0x00FFEFE0.
function.caller: ActorType15_PlayerCollisionHandler at 0x001AE978 invokes the helper three times before selecting the player response animation.

conclusion: The far-transfer interaction counter has explicit decrement semantics that complement the existing increment helper; it is a bounded two-digit ASCII state word rather than an opaque flag.
